Tees
Forecast mode: each hole uses the wind for when you reach it (about 14 min a hole from your tee time, counting from your starting hole). Moving the dial or speed switches to Custom, one wind for every hole. Drag the dial to where the wind blows from: the round yellow end sits where the wind comes from, and the arrow points where it is blowing to, like the arrows on the hole cards.
